fusions.name: Sodden Cud
fusions.desc: Spits a sodden mouthful of cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Reeds
fusions.desc: Springs up to 5 tiles onto an enemy and lands your full weight on it, which deals 14 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pond Wallow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Clear
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
